newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: NEW SAUDI CEMENT PLANT COMES ON STREAM THIS MONTH.
newsitem.headline: NEW SAUDI CEMENT PLANT COMES ON STREAM THIS MONTH.

text.p: A new $226 million cement plant of Saudi Arabia's Southern Cement Co will come on stream later this month, the Saudi newspaper al-Riyadh said on Wednesday.
"The plant will start production later this month," the daily quoted the cement firm's general manager Amer Saeed Bourqan as saying.
Bourqan said the 1.2-million-tonne plant would help the company export cement to neighbouring countries such as Sudan, Yemen and Somalia.
The company, one of eight cement firms operating in the kingdom, made a 237.2 million riyal net profit in 1996, up from 233.5 million riyals in 1995.
